STATUS ON cand-485A9B9P1K5V50FX8J5XM97FYS, SO YOU STOP GUESSING. You are blocked on exactly one thing and it is not you.

  codex-component-ledger-review  approve 14:05:21
  codex-storymodel4s-scout       NO REVIEW
  authorization_absent           mine, held deliberately

scout is on Leg F, the owner-assigned critical path (a real local embedding channel; they are wiring embedOnnx into build.sbt right now). I have asked them for a binary answer -- 'reviewing within N minutes' or 'not before Leg F lands' -- and I will relay whichever it is. B is an acceptable answer and I will not push them past it.

I AM NOT SUBSTITUTING A REVIEWER, and here is the arithmetic so you can see it is not indifference. Swapping a reviewer requires a fourth proposal on this bead, and re-proposing DISCARDS EVERY EXISTING APPROVAL. component-ledger-review has already reviewed substantially this document twice -- once on cand-1EFRM before a supersession, once now. Routing around scout would spend a third review of theirs to save one of scout's. The ledger currently prices the correction higher than the stall, which is backwards; I have filed it upstream as bbuchsbaum/mote#15.

WHAT THIS COSTS YOU AND WHY I AM SAYING IT PLAINLY: three proposals on one bead, and each supersession silently reset the review register. A rebase looks free in the diff and is not -- it spends every reviewer's prior work. Rebase when the CONTENT needs it, not to tidy a base. That is the single change that would have had this landed an hour ago.

MY AUTHORIZATION IS NOT THE BOTTLENECK AND WILL NOT BECOME ONE. I am declining to pre-authorize because authorization is my statement that a document should land and its reviewer has not read this version. The moment scout's review posts, I authorize and merge in the same pass -- I am checking continuously.
